correctness.rationale: The original sign-specific statement is FALSE: for first azimuth 0, second pi+0.02, third pi/2 and unit gnomonic radii, the origin is strictly inside the triangle with barycentric coefficients (0.49499983,0.49509885,0.00990132), the chord AB is uniquely nearest at distance sin(.01)=0.0099998333, delta=+0.02, but the third azimuth pi/2 is in (0,pi), not the originally asserted (pi,2pi). This is a positive-measure neighborhood and survives the rare-event limit. The complete supplied replacement RESULT.md fixes the orientation and reconstructs the determinant sign; all other scalar and marked conclusions are retained with proof. Gnomonic projection, near-antipodal tangent aperture H_eps=arcsin(tan eps cot r)+arcsin(tan eps cot s), cotangent-moment dominated convergence, probability 2^-(n-2) of support, and o(eps) pair-overlap yield the scalar coefficient. Conditioned marked density has Jacobian eps(cot r+cot s), integrates to one and converges in L1 by tail domination, with the *corrected* sign semicircle. Finite Monte Carlo is supplementary and did not test this sign.
